newsitem.title: USA: Hospitality Properties adopts rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Hospitality Properties adopts rights plan.

text.p: Hospitality Properties Trust said on Wednesday it adopted a shareholder rights plan to ensure that any potential suitor negotiates with Hospitality's board before attempting a takeover.
Hospitality said in a news release that the rights plan would be triggered if someone acquired 10 percent or more of the trust's common shares.
The company did not say in the release whether it was aware of any current takeover interest. Hospitality officials were not immediately available for comment on this point.

Hospitality also said in the release that its shareholders at their annual meeting on Wednesday voted to allow the board of trustees to change the number of authorized shares without a shareholder vote.
Hospitality is a real estate investment trust with current investments and commitments of $1 billion in 97 hotels in 29 states.Its shares were up 1/4 to 31-1/8 in mid-afternoon trading.
